spec.note: E6b rigid evaluation spec, frozen before any evaluation outcome is synced (sha256 in LOG.md). Family = PLAN 7.3: soil M3 vs M1 and A3 vs M1 on fail (no soil data yet: p = 1, the conservative placeholder), rigid fixed 2 m/s M3 vs M1 and A3 vs M1 on unsafe, pooled over the 8 unseen arenas, Holm over the four one-sided cluster p-values. With the soil tests at p = 1 the rigid Holm-adjusted p-values are upper bounds (Holm adjusted p is non-decreasing in the other p-values): a rigid rejection here stays a rejection; a non-rejection is provisional until the soil tests exist. Arms: <model>_free = CEM 4x64 speed free, <model>_fx2 = CEM 4x64 at fixed 2 m/s, straight6 / straight2 = designed straight anchor at 6 / 2 m/s; composite M1_* / M3_* = per-group mean of the a/b ensembles (REVIEW_R1 4). Task B: G_free_gator / H_free_gator / straight6_gator on the Gator; H on the HMMWV = M1a_free (H is the M1a ensemble). Task B fixed 2 m/s rule, declared here: speed-free rigid goal reaching is "at the ceiling" if G on the Gator, H on the Gator and H on the HMMWV each reach the goal on >= 97 % of the 800 groups; then G and H at fixed 2 m/s and straight 2 m/s are driven on the Gator (all 800 groups) and G vs H on the Gator at fixed 2 m/s on unsafe is the rigid task B read-out (spec addendum, arms G_fx2_gator / H_fx2_gator / straight2_gator).
